measurementRule: Do not judge an experiment before a complete comparable 28-day window. Record seven-day values only as leading indicators.

measurementProtocol.restartTrigger: Any search-facing change to the title, description, H1, first answer, structured data, canonical, or indexability resets the window.
measurementProtocol.pendingWindowRule: For pending-clean-window experiments, set releaseDate to the production merge date and evaluate the 28 complete days beginning the next day.

experiments.hypothesis: A year-specific regional title and direct transplant-date first answer will lift CTR from 0.26% toward 2.0% without changing the canonical.
experiments.stopCondition: Canonical, structured data, or indexability changes unexpectedly.

experiments.hypothesis: A city-and-calendar title plus an immediate statewide range will lift CTR from 0.11% toward 2.0%.
experiments.stopCondition: City table, filters, canonical, or indexability regress.

experiments.hypothesis: Matching the depth query in the title, H1, FAQ, and first answer will lift CTR from 0.54% toward 1.5%.
experiments.stopCondition: Factual source links, canonical, or existing ecology query coverage regress.

experiments.hypothesis: A tonight-led title, crawlable regional Michigan outlooks, and a fail-soft same-origin NOAA feed will lift CTR from 1.85% toward 2.5% while answering city and regional intent without mass-producing thin location pages.
experiments.stopCondition: NOAA parsing, map behavior, or existing manual fallback regresses.

experiments.hypothesis: A schedule-today title plus an honest three-step source flow—BoatNerd named vessels, the official USACE hotline, and the live AIS map—will better satisfy today and tomorrow schedule intent and lift CTR from 1.26% toward 2.5%.
experiments.stopCondition: Named-vessel data is republished without permission or the live map regresses.

experiments.hypothesis: A conditions-today title, an immediate open-today answer, and contextual links from Soo Locks and Aurora will move the new page from average position 15.46 toward page one and lift CTR from 0.89% toward 2.0%.
experiments.primaryMetric: Search Console page impressions, CTR, and average position
experiments.stopCondition: The official Bridge Authority source, fail-safe open/closed logic, cameras, canonical, or live crossing flow regresses.

experiments.hypothesis: A clearer Zone 6a title, first-party experience framing, and contextual links into the gardening hub, tomato guide, and frost tool will grow qualified impressions and send measurable readers deeper into the gardening cluster.
experiments.primaryMetric: Search Console impressions and aggregate internal CTA clicks
experiments.stopCondition: First-party claims, canonicals, or links to the independent Freighter View Farms blog become inaccurate.

experiments.hypothesis: A migration-and-hotspot title, direct first answer, and prominent bridge to the live birding tool will lift guide CTR and expand impressions without weakening the birding subdomain's existing 4.5% CTR.
experiments.primaryMetric: Search Console page impressions, CTR, and aggregate clicks to the live birding tool
experiments.stopCondition: The guide loses indexability, the live-tool destination changes, or birding-subdomain CTR falls below 2.5% in a comparable 28-day window.

experiments.hypothesis: Replacing the passive guide with a live lake-wide AIS tool, corridor-specific views, nearby NOAA context, and a title matching ship-tracker intent will move the page toward the top 15 and lift CTR from 0.10% toward 1.5%.
experiments.primaryMetric: Search Console page impressions, CTR, and average position
experiments.stopCondition: The supported AIS embed, corridor switching, nearby NOAA context, canonical, or non-JavaScript source links regress.

experiments.hypothesis: A shipping-news-today title, direct link to the dated newspaper, visible archive and RSS, and current-headline distribution across relevant high-demand pages will establish qualified search demand and repeat edition opens while publication health prevents stale or silently broken issues.
experiments.primaryMetric: Daily publication availability, widget edition-open rate, and Search Console landing-page CTR after a complete baseline window
experiments.stopCondition: A duplicate issue, wrong-date headline link, stale movement framed as current, source-health false positive, indexability change, or material live-tool performance regression occurs.
